text: CORRECTION to the preceding implementation note: the displacement metric is NOT a lag-two recall comparison. “Two-step versus five-step reversal” means the source-space magnitude of one adjacent recall transition. The metric identity should be route:transition-displacement-closeness and, on each eligible adjacent source-to-source pair, score 1 - abs(abs(gold relativePosition delta) - abs(inferred relativePosition delta)). Direction remains the separate signed agreement metric. This correction matches the accepted design checkpoint and the bead’s original boundary.
